messages:
olivia: Hey team — urgent customer report from Acme (acme-inc). After a model swap on our hosted embeddings endpoint they're getting large numbers of rejects from their vector DB. Error: "indexer: invalid vector length 128 != expected 1536". They started ingest at ~10:02 UTC and it's still failing. Can someone pull logs?

sam-support: I can take first look. Do we know which model delivered the 128-dim vectors? Acme says they called /v1/embeddings with model 'embed-lite-v2' during deployment.

nisha-ml: embed-lite-v2 is a tiny model that outputs 128 dims — that sounds like the cause. Did they intend to switch to our default 1536 model?

kevin-eng: We have two problems: 1) the API allowed the request (no validation against customer vecdb schema), 2) the indexer assumes schema fixed at 1536. So the pipeline accepted the embeddings and forwarded to indexer which then rejected.

alex-sre: Deploy bot shows a config rollout at 2026-03-17T10:01:05Z where acme project pinned model=embed-lite-v2 via console. deploy-bot: rollout_id=rl_93a2.

deploy-bot: notice: rollout rl_93a2 applied to project acme-inc; change: model -> embed-lite-v2 (was embed-1536).

olivia: Customer is asking for a quick mitigation: either stop rejects (so no billing spike) or backfill failed records. Any quick workarounds?

sam-support: Immediate mitigations: 1) Pause the indexer consumer for acme (prevents further rejects). 2) Enable a silent drop/metric for vectors with wrong dim (so they don't get billed for retries). I can pause consumer if ops approves.

kevin-eng: I can flip a per-project validation to reject mismatched requests at the API edge before they get stored — returns 400 with a hint: "expected 1536-dim embedding; received 128". That stops bad vectors from entering pipeline.

nisha-ml: For backfill: if they want to reindex, they need embeddings from embed-1536 for the documents that were processed while embed-lite-v2 was live. We should produce a backfill plan: 1) list ingested record ids with rejected flag 2) regenerate embeddings with correct model 3) replay to indexer.

alex-sre: Logged an incident ticket INC-2026-0432 and increased logging retention for acme project for 24h. Also watching for CPU/GPU billing anomalies.

indexer-bot: Warning: last 5m reject rate for acme-inc = 74%; primary error = VECTOR_LENGTH_MISMATCH (expected=1536, got=128).

sam-support: Repro steps for internal ops: 
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"embed-lite-v2","input":"hello"}' 
2) Observe: payload.embeddings[0].length == 128 -> indexer reject.

kevin-eng: Quick fix I pushed: API now checks project schema on write and rejects mismatched dim requests with 400. Pushed a rollbackable flag — rolling out to 10% then 100% for support.

olivia: Customer asked about billing credits for the failed inserts. Finance expects an ops postmortem + list of rejected ids. Maya in billing will need the counts.

sam-support: Action items: 
- pausing indexer consumer for acme (sam)
- apply API validation globally (kevin)
- produce list of rejected ids + ingest timestamps (kevin/sam)
- backfill plan + ETA (nisha)
- billing credit estimate (finance)

nisha-ml: Backfill ETA: with existing throughput we can regen + replay ~50k docs/hour once we schedule a backfill job. Will need customer confirmation to reprocess content.

olivia: I'll notify Acme support contact, propose pause+rollback to embed-1536, offer to coordinate backfill. Thanks everyone — keep updates in this thread.

sam-support: Paused consumer for acme-inc at 10:11:42 UTC. confirm: no new indexer rejects after pause.

indexer-bot: Info: consumer acme-inc paused by sam-support.

kevin-eng: API validation rolled to 100% at 10:14:05 UTC. Any clients now sending embed-lite-v2 get a 400 with message: "Embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536. If you intentionally changed models, update your project's vector schema or contact support."

olivia: Customer agreed to backfill and would like an ETA and cost estimate. I'll open a ticket with them and share the plan. Closing loop once backfill completes.

alex-sre: Leaving monitoring alerts on for 48h. If any other projects got the same model swap, we should proactively scan recent rollouts.

sam-support: scanning rollouts for embedded model swaps now; will post results.

nisha-ml: note for follow-up: we should add a console warning when changing models that change embedding dim, and optionally block if project has a pinned vecdb schema.

olivia: Good suggestion. Marking as product follow-up.

sam-support: scan done — acme-inc was the only active project that flipped to embed-lite-v2 in the last 24h.

olivia: thanks. I'll update customer and set next steps.
